value.rationale: Recent numerical particle solvers choose rank matching because it minimizes partner distance. The new construction proves their choice can lose essentially all variance savings even though another legal matching preserves a fixed, asymptotically sharp 41.42 percent share of independent variance; the explicit uniqueness condition permits an algorithmic alternative. It does not claim full nonlinear simulation improvement.
